name: The player found when played again and again from My Bookmarks (Bookmarks 1.1.5): each Play from here adds a player view and the web client keeps up to three, the earlier ones hidden, in page slots whose order the shown one doesn't follow. Six plays, Replay A on Long Test Movie and Replay B on Chaptered Movie in turn; after each, Set end time on the shown view opens its chooser with the playing video's bookmark (1.1.4 said 'Start playing a video' whenever a hidden view came first). At least one play must have the shown view after a hidden one. As admin; the two bookmarks made first and removed at the end.

steps.eval: (await ApiClient.getItems(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), { IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', Recursive: true, SearchTerm: 'Long Test Movie', Limit: 1 })).Items[0].Id

steps.name: Chaptered Movie
steps.eval: (await ApiClient.getItems(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), { IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', Recursive: true, SearchTerm: 'Chaptered Movie', Limit: 1 })).Items[0].Id

steps.name: reset both movies' bookmarks to 'Replay A' (Long Test Movie, 0:05) and 'Replay B' (Chaptered Movie, 0:05)
steps.script: const post = (p, body) => ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: ApiClient.getUrl(p), data: JSON.stringify(body), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' }); for (const id of [__vars.a, __vars.b]) { for (const x of await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks', { itemId: id }))) { await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'DELETE', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/' + x.Id, { deleteClip: 'true' }) }); } } await post('Bookmarks', { ItemId: __vars.a, StartTicks: 50000000, Name: 'Replay A' }); await post('Bookmarks', { ItemId: __vars.b, StartTicks: 50000000, Name: 'Replay B' }); return true;
